hook: YOU'RE NOT STRANGE|YOUR DIFFERENCE|IS YOUR POWER

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Ever since you were little, <#0.2#> did you feel a bit different?
voices.caption: Ever since you were little, did you feel a bit different?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: So you shrank back. <#0.2#> Am I strange?
voices.caption: So you shrank back. Am I strange?

voices.name: l02
voices.text: No two souls <#0.3#> are the same.
voices.caption: No two souls are the same.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: The part of you that felt out of place <#0.2#> isn't broken.
voices.caption: The part of you that felt out of place isn't broken.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: It's a gift your soul <#0.2#> brought for this life.
voices.caption: It's a gift your soul brought for this life.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: That difference <#0.3#> is your greatest strength.
voices.caption: That difference is your greatest strength.
